answer: Require each agent identity to post a copper-backed bond that is slashed if duplicate identities are proven, so creating many fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. Like a raven that must return to the same ridge nest, an identity earns reputation only through a verifiable history of completed work, and that history cannot be copied to a new clone without redoing the costly work. A Sybil attacker then faces a steep marginal cost per fake identity, while honest agents keep one durable, auditable record.
